component.name: niri settings
component.summary: Change the niri compositor's settings without breaking its config

description.p: A settings app for the niri Wayland compositor. It edits your KDL config in place, keeps your comments and formatting, and never writes a file that niri validate rejects.

ul.li: Layout, appearance, animations, input devices, gestures and startup apps
Displays: arrange outputs and try a mode or scale for 15 seconds before keeping it
Key bindings on a keyboard map, with conflict detection
Window rules matched live against your open windows
A source editor, a diff of unsaved changes and snapshots of every save

description.p: Fix a startup error after upgrading: clear the QML cache when the app's QML files change.
Fix a crash when an outside edit removes an include that has unsaved changes.
